title: He watched her pour into the measure and thence into the jug rich white milk, not hers. Old shrunken paps.
html_source: These lines contrast an old woman pouring from a jug, “rich white milk,” specifically observed as “not hers,” to the “old shrunken paps” of the woman. This perhaps falls toward the weathering aspects of age, where an older, (presumably) sterile woman supplies “rich white milk,” marking the exchange from fertility to infertility.
